newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Foreningsbanken farmer groups switch to A shares.
newsitem.headline: Foreningsbanken farmer groups switch to A shares.

text.p: Swedish Farmers' associations which control Swedish banking group Foreningsbanken will change their non-listed preferential C shares to listed ordinary A shares, Foreningsbanken said on Friday.
The associations are Lantbrukarnas Ekonomi AB, Lantbrukarnas Trygghetsforsakring AB, Slakteriforbundet and Lansforsakringsbolagens AB.
As a consequence of the change, the number of listed A shares will rise to 221,898,333 from 182,500,000, while the number of C shares will fall to 20,601,667 from 60,000,000, the bank said.
The total number of shares will remain at 261,000,000.

Previously, the associations have blocked tentative takeover plans on Foreningsbanken by banking group Swedbank but one analyst did not see this move as intended to pave the way for acceptance of a Swedbank offer.
"This is just a logical step," he said, adding that it was a purely technical move.
